name: universal-agents
title: Universal Agents
description: Ask Universal Agents what we sell, our pricing, and common questions; draft an intro email. Read-only.

toolsDigest.of: the tools/list result as JSON, keys sorted, no whitespace

data_reach.stores: Nothing a caller sends is stored, except one line per tools/call in the runtime log: the tool name, the client name and version given at initialize, the outcome and the time.
data_reach.request_intro: Its arguments are never logged. The server drafts the email and sends nothing.

trust.auth: none — public information only, by design

attestations.statement: None held: no SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar certification or audit.

trust.signed: Nothing is signed: not the server card, the ARD manifest or the replies.

identity.statement: did:web ties this identity to control of the domain: resolving it fetches the DID document from the domain over HTTPS. It proves nothing more: nothing is signed with its key yet.

fields.provenance: answer_type (code, pricing or product); authors, each with name and title; the one accountable person, with name, title and contact; for pricing and product answers, the ua-brain source (repo, path) and the date it took effect. answer_faq carries it on the reply and on each answer.
fields.agent_may: What an agent may do with the answer unsupervised: level, label and note, a level on the Delegation Map Trust Scale, 1 Tell to 7 Hands Off.

1.label: Tell
1.means: The agent may pass the answer on as stated, without asking anyone.

3.label: Consult
3.means: The agent may propose; the person decides and acts.

7.label: Hands Off
7.means: The agent does not act: the matter goes to the accountable person via the contact.
